(tickets_sold, ticket_type.sold) and marks order as paid\r\n */\r\nasync function handleEventOrderCompleted(\r\n  session: Stripe.Checkout.Session,\r\n  orderId: string,\r\n  supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createSupabaseServerClient>>\r\n) {\r\n  console.log(`≡ƒÄ½ [handleEventOrderCompleted] Processing event order | order_id=${orderId} | session=${session.id}`);\r\n\r\n  const (!ticketType) continue;\r\n\r\n    totalTickets += item.quantity;\r\n\r\n    // Check ticket type availability\r\n    if (ticketType.quantity !== null) {\r\n      if (ticketType.sold + item.quantity > console.error(`Γ¥î [handleEventOrderCompleted] Event capacity exceeded | event_id=${order.event_id}`);\r\n      await admin\r\n        .from(\"event_orders\")\r\n        .update({ status: \"cancelled\", updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })\r\n        .eq(\"id\", orderId);\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // Use transaction-like approach: update all inventory atomically\r\n  // Update ticket types sold counts\r\n  for (const item of orderItems) {\r\n    const ticketType = ticketTypeMap.get(item.ticket_type_id);\r\n    if (!ticketType) continue;\r\n\r\n    const { error: .from(\"events\")\r\n    .update({\r\n      tickets_sold: event.tickets_sold + totalTickets,\r\n      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),\r\n    })\r\n    .eq(\"id\", order.event_id);\r\n\r\n  if (eventUpdateError) {\r\n    console.error(`Γ¥î [handleEventOrderCompleted] Failed to update event tickets_sold: ${eventUpdateError.message}`);\r\n    // Rollback ticket types (complex, but mark order
